Book questions

What this book is for

Answered from the same facts the shelf shows, nothing more.

Who is High School English Grammar & Composition for?

The classic grammar reference - read the chapters behind the errors you keep making in the English section.

What does High School English Grammar & Composition cover?

A complete English grammar reference covering Parts of Speech, Tenses, Voice, Narration, Sentence Correction, Vocabulary and Composition with hundreds of practice exercises.

Which exams is High School English Grammar & Composition useful for?

Punjab Police, PSSSB, Staff Selection Commission, Banking Exams, Railway, General competitive.
